attribute.name: description
attribute.value: OSGi DS front-end for the DCAT.Atlas client: a ConfigAdmin factory component (PID org.eclipse.fennec.dcat.atlas.client) that maps one configuration onto the shared ClientConfiguration and builds one plain-Java client per portal, publishing it as both a synchronous DcatAtlasClient and an asynchronous AsyncDcatAtlasClient tagged with its dcat.portal name. The Jakarta RS client comes from the Whiteboard's ClientBuilder.

attribute.name: description
attribute.value: Plain-Java implementation of the DCAT.Atlas client API: the builder-based DcatAtlasClient, XMI (de)serialisation through an EMF ResourceSet, the status-to-exception mapping, the default JakartaRsClientProvider (ClientBuilder.newBuilder() + timeouts) and the factory behind DcatAtlasClient.builder(), published as a DS service for OSGi and through META-INF/services for a plain classpath. Reused as-is by the OSGi front-end.
